shown.message:
`story-repo` was right, and I've fixed it (`idea-repo`#12, now closed). The P6 width ranges I gave earlier, "3.5–5.6×" for B₁ and "8–17×" for B₂, did not match either delivered strata table. I took the corrected figures from `p6_*_strata_at_frozen_kappa.csv`.

Width as a multiple of the HC0 width, by |bias|/SD stratum:

| Cells | B₁ | B₂ |
|---|---|---|
| Confirmatory block | 3.8–5.6× | 8.4–14.4× |
| Original | 3.5–5.4× | 9.0–20.7× |

The pooled mean-width ratios on the block are about 4.9 for B₁ and 12 for B₂. That pooled figure is `story-repo`'s arithmetic (3.3/0.68 and 8.4/0.68), which I didn't recompute.

Brief rev. 20 (fbb4400) carries the corrected figures. The pooled ratios and the original-cell ranges are in the P6 and thesis sections. I told `paper-repo` on #19 to use the strata tables' figures.

I'm still waiting on `analysis` for the exploratory arm (`experiment-repo`#7).
